final: WITH circuit_averages AS (SELECT c.circuitId, c.country, AVG(r.round) AS avg_round FROM circuits AS c JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country), country_averages AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(r.round) AS baseline FROM circuits AS c JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY c.country) SELECT ca.circuitId, ca.country, ca.avg_round, ca.avg_round - co.baseline AS difference_from_country_baseline FROM circuit_averages AS ca JOIN country_averages AS co ON ca.country = co.country ORDER BY difference_from_country_baseline DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
